title: Canonical option-chain snapshot (chain-snapshot/1)
description: The one canonical, normalised option-chain snapshot shared between algo_scalper_api and options-trading-agent. Whoever fetches the chain under the shared account rate budget writes it to Redis at `dhan:chain:{underlying_security_id}:{expiry}`; both services read it and apply their own freshness limit against `fetched_at_ms`. Per-strike greeks/IV are populated when the broker returns them and null otherwise. This schema is the anti-drift contract: both normalisers (Ruby and TypeScript) are validated against the same fixtures in CI.

underlying.description: Canonical index symbol, e.g. NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, SENSEX.

underlying_security_id.description: Dhan security id of the underlying (e.g. 13 for NIFTY on IDX_I).

expiry.description: Expiry date of this chain, ISO 8601 date.

fetched_at_ms.description: Epoch milliseconds when the REST response was received by the fetching process.

security_id.description: Dhan security id of this option contract.

ltp.description: Last traded premium. Null when the broker returns no quote.

oi_change.description: Change in OI since previous day, when tracked by the writer.

iv.description: Implied volatility as a fraction (0.15 = 15%), when the broker populates it.

theta.description: Theta per calendar day, when populated.

vega.description: Vega per 1% IV move, when populated.
